description: Maryland Road Closures is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Road Closures in the State of Maryland provided by Maryland Department of Transportation Coordinated Highways Action Response Team (MDOT CHART). Road Closures created by local jurisdictions are not included as part of this dataset. Coverage: Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are chart, transportation, roads, md, mdot. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Maryland Department of Transportation Coordinated Highways Action Response Team. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
